summary: KULR Technology Group filed an 8-K reporting the sale of approximately 333 bitcoin (BTC) between July 9-23, 2026, at a weighted average price of ~$64,538 per BTC, generating ~$21.5 million in gross proceeds. The sales were part of treasury management operations. Net proceeds were used to fully repay a $20.0 million credit facility with Coinbase Credit, Inc., releasing all 565 BTC previously pledged as collateral. No principal remains outstanding; accrued interest is expected in August 2026. Remaining net proceeds will fund general corporate purposes. The company retains ~760 BTC and a largely debt-free balance sheet. This is a capital allocation and debt repayment event, not an acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation category.
